calendar.event.created.description: Published when a calendar event is created.

calendar.event.updated.description: Published when a calendar event is updated.

finance.inbox_item.approved.description: Published when an inbox item is approved into the ledger.

finance.inbox_item.created.description: Published when a new pending inbox item is staged.

finance.scheduled_transaction.created.description: Published when a pending scheduled transaction is created.

finance.scheduled_transaction.paid.description: Published when a scheduled transaction transitions to paid.

finance.scheduled_transaction.updated.description: Published when a scheduled transaction is modified.

finance.transaction.created.description: Published when a ledger transaction is created.

mail.message.received.description: Published on incremental delta syncs for newly ingested inbound messages.

ai.agent_run.description: Executes a workspace AI agent headlessly in a multi-step MCP-enabled run.

calendar.upsert_event.description: Creates or idempotently updates a calendar event keyed by a deterministic iCalUID derived from external_ref.

document.extract_text.description: Extracts plain text from PDF, CSV, or text artifacts with optional password decryption.

filter.description: Evaluates a CEL boolean condition; halts the run cleanly with status 'filtered' if false.

finance.create_inbox_item.description: Stages an extracted financial receipt, invoice, or bank notification into the finance inbox queue with idempotency.

finance.import_statement_draft.description: Validates multi-currency ledger math and credit-card liability signs, resolves accounts, and persists finance.Statement drafts.

for_each.description: Iterates sequentially over a CEL list, binding loop.<alias>.item and loop.<alias>.index.

llm.generate.description: Prompts a configured model or semantic role with optional structured JSON output schema and document attachments.

mail.create_draft.description: Creates an email draft locally and syncs it to the connected mail provider.

mail.modify_labels.description: Adds/removes mailbox labels or archives an email thread.

mail.save_thread_summary.description: Persists an AI-generated TL;DR, key points, and action items as the cached summary of an email thread.

output.description: Terminates the current path and sets FlowRun.output for synchronous callers.

stop.description: Terminates the current branch or run cleanly with status 'stopped'.

switch.description: Evaluates ordered CEL case conditions and executes the first matching branch before rejoining.

transform.description: Evaluates arbitrary CEL expressions in inputs and binds the resulting object to steps.<id>.

calendar.calendars.description: Lists workspace calendars, optionally filtered to writable calendars only.

calendar.event.description: Retrieves a single calendar event by ID or deterministic external_ref.

calendar.events.description: Queries expanded calendar occurrences in a time window, optionally filtered by calendar_id or search query.

finance.account.description: Resolves a single account by exact ID in the workspace, falling back to name, last four digits, and currency.

finance.accounts.description: Lists workspace financial accounts, optionally filtered by currency or type.

finance.borrowings.description: Lists workspace borrowing/lending agreements, optionally filtered by status.

finance.budget.description: Resolves a single budget by ID first, then case-insensitive name.

finance.budgets.description: Lists workspace budgets, optionally filtered by status.

finance.recurring_templates.description: Lists recurring transaction templates, optionally filtered by status.

finance.scheduled_payments.description: Lists scheduled transactions, optionally filtered by status, type, or due window.

finance.transactions.description: Queries recent ledger transactions with optional amount tolerance, date window, account, and search filters (capped at 100).

mail.mailboxes.description: Lists mail folders and labels, optionally filtered by connected_account_id.

mail.message.description: Loads email metadata, cached plain/HTML body, and mail:// attachment artifact references.

mail.thread.description: Loads a thread with chronological sanitized plain-text message bodies capped for LLM token budgets.

addDays.description: Adds signed days to a YYYY-MM-DD date or RFC3339 timestamp.

formatMoney.description: Formats cents and ISO currency code into a display string.

fromCents.description: Converts integer cents into a decimal currency number.

inSpaceTz.description: Parses an RFC3339 timestamp or YYYY-MM-DD date in the workspace timezone.

localTime.description: Combines a date or timestamp with HH:MM in the workspace timezone and returns RFC3339.

toCents.description: Converts a decimal currency amount into rounded minor units (cents).

toJSON.description: Serializes any value to deterministic JSON.
